english.title: Use an animal trap in circumstances for which it is not approved
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), for the purpose of killing or taking animals, used or knowingly permitted the use of

(A)_[a spring trap other than an approved trap]_
(B)_[an approved trap for animals for which it was not approved]_
(C)_[an approved trap in circumstances for which it was not approved]_

in that **(..SPECIFY MISUSE OF TRAP..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 8(1)(a) and (2) of the Pests Act 1954.
